name: cross-model-review-codex
description: Defect reviewer and fixer backed by the Codex CLI. Review and verification run in a read-only sandbox; fixes run in a workspace-write sandbox without network.

extensions.description: Requests are a single DataPart matching the skill-request schema; results are an Artifact named '<skill>-result' with a single DataPart matching the skill-result schema.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Per-run random token shared by the orchestrator.

skills.name: Review changes (read-only)
skills.description: Independent defect review of the uncommitted change set. Read-only sandbox.

skills.name: Fix findings (write-enabled)
skills.description: Fix the given findings with minimal edits. workspace-write sandbox, no network, exclusive workspace lock.

skills.name: Verify fixes (read-only)
skills.description: Check whether given findings are resolved and whether fixes introduced new defects. Read-only sandbox.
